unitDefinition.desc: 沿合法通路瞬身前进，投掷独立小刀；受击可打断未出手攻击。

blink.budget: One speed * cycle allowance per cadence; move multiplier shortens distance; no banking or reorder resets.
blink.laneChange: Only native graph-certified connectors are traversed with the same distance budget; switch lane at the exact validated endpoint. Recheck checkpoint and adjacency during transit.

registration: Registered as t_cell. WarTCellRuntime owns native navigation handoffs, blink movement, dedicated knife combat, rendering and save state; generic movement/projectile launch is bypassed.
artSemantics: Original 56 frames, pivots, alpha and timing retained. Throw renders bodyRects only; separate projectile renders projectileArt from the same unchanged atlas.
